description: This file defines a Razor Pages PageModel class 'IndexModel' which manages catalog display logic for the index page, including dependency injection of a catalog service and handling GET requests to fetch catalog items.

classes.name: IndexModel
classes.description: PageModel class for the Index Razor page, responsible for handling catalog data retrieval and page initialization.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Asynchronous handler for HTTP GET requests to initialize the catalog view model with items, applying optional pagination and filters.
